title: A Reflective LLM-based Agent to Guide Zero-shot Cryptocurrency Trading

task.value: Making daily zero-shot cryptocurrency trading decisions (buy/sell/hold proportions) for BTC, ETH and SOL using an LLM agent combining on-chain and off-chain data.
task.quote: This work aims to bridge the gap by developing an LLM-based trading agent, CryptoTrade, which uniquely combines the analysis of on-chain and off-chain data.

architecture.value: Data collection and statistics/news summarization (GPT-3.5-turbo), then market analyst, news analyst, trading agent and a reflection agent that reviews the previous week's prompts, decisions and returns to give feedback.
architecture.quote: Finally, we enhance day-to-day decision-making with specialized analytical agents: market analyst agent evaluates market trends, news analyst agent interprets recent news impacts, and trading agent deliberates on investment actions. Concurrently, reflection agent reviews past performance

data.value: Daily CoinMarketCap prices/volume/market cap for BTC, ETH, SOL; Dune on-chain transaction statistics (transactions, active wallets, value transferred, gas); news via Gnews API from outlets like Bloomberg, Yahoo Finance, crypto.news.
data.quote: We leverage historical data from CoinMarketCap55 5 https://coinmarketcap.com, which provides daily insights into prices, trading volumes, and market capitalization of various cryptocurrencies: BTC, ETH, SOL.

window.value: Validation in early 2023 (e.g., BTC 2023-01-19 to 2023-03-13); tests in 2023: bearish 2023-04-12 to 2023-06-16, sideways (BTC 2023-06-17 to 2023-08-25, varies by coin), bullish 2023-10-01 to 2023-12-01.

models.value: GPT-3.5-turbo for news summarization/analysts; trading experiments with GPT-4, GPT-4o (text) and tables report GPT-4 and GPT-3.5-turbo. No snapshot versions given.
models.quote: Then, we conduct comprehensive experiments with CryptoTrade using GPT-422 2 https://platform.openai.com/docs/models/gpt-4, and GPT-4o33 3 https://platform.openai.com/docs/models/gpt-4o

baselines.value: Buy and Hold, SMA, SLMA, MACD, Bollinger Bands, LSTM, Informer, AutoFormer, TimesNet, PatchTST.
baselines.quote: CryptoTrade significantly outperforms time-series baselines such as Informer Zhou et al. (2021) and PatchTST Nie et al. (2022), and achieves comparable performance to trading signals like Moving Average Convergence Divergence (MACD) Gencay (1996)

headline_result.value: ETH bullish test (2023-10-01 to 2023-12-01): Ours(GPT-4) total return 25.72% vs Buy and Hold 22.59%, Sharpe 0.17 vs 0.14.

costs.value: A transaction fee proportional to traded value is charged; rate not given.
costs.quote: When a trading decision is made, a transaction fee is charged in proportion to the traded value.

leakage_controls.value: Test period chosen after September 2021, GPT-3.5's knowledge cutoff.
leakage_controls.quote: We carefully select the test period after September 2021, the GPT-3.5’s knowledge cutoff date, to prevent data leakage.

limitations.value: Limited dataset; daily-only trading frequency; no fine-tuning on validation set possibly causing underperformance versus traditional signals.
limitations.quote: One limitation of the current CryptoTrade framework is the reliance on a relatively limited dataset.

release.value: Code and data released at an anonymous 4open.science link; dataset under CC BY-NC-SA; plan to host on GitHub.
release.quote: Our code and data are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CryptoTrade-Public-92FC/.
